svg.title: EntryDesk: specialist evidence to portfolio weights
svg.desc: Market charts and macro indicators feed the market analyst; earnings calendars, past reactions and stock context feed the earnings analyst; company headlines and price moves feed the news analyst; model ranks, volatility forecasts and portfolio signals feed the quant analyst. Each supplies an independent report to the portfolio manager, which chooses stock weights. Code supplies a risk critique for one confirm-or-revise step and applies validation and exposure sizing. Charts and allocations are schematic; optional SEC filing text is omitted from the recorded contest entry.
svg.text: Point-in-time inputs · independent reports · one bounded decision
Schematic charts and allocation. Shared clock/book context omitted; SEC filing text excluded in the recorded entry.
